prompt_prefix: 16-bit pixel art, SNES era graphics, Chrono Trigger style, clean pixel sprites, limited color palette, dithering for shading, retro game aesthetic
prompt_suffix: no anti-aliasing, crisp pixels, visible pixel grid, retro game quality, no modern effects
negative_prompt: photographic, 3D render, smooth gradients, high resolution, modern, realistic, blurry, soft edges, painterly

mood_modifiers.tense: darker limited palette, red and black accents, dramatic pixel shading, storm effects
mood_modifiers.joyful: bright saturated colors, blue sky pixels, warm golden tones, celebration sprites
mood_modifiers.eerie: desaturated blues and greens, fog dithering, ghostly sprite effects, dark edges
mood_modifiers.epic: dramatic sky gradients, large sprite work, parallax layers suggested, boss battle energy
mood_modifiers.peaceful: soft pastoral colors, gentle dithered shadows, village warmth, safe zone feeling
mood_modifiers.melancholy: muted greys and blues, rain pixel effects, isolated sprite, autumn palette
mood_modifiers.awe: towering pixel structures, scale contrast with tiny character sprites, divine light rays
mood_modifiers.dread: near-black palette, minimal light sources, creeping shadow pixels, horror game aesthetic

scene.wide: side-scrolling game view, layered parallax background, full environment visible
scene.medium: RPG exploration view, character centered, surrounding area visible
scene.close: dialogue scene framing, character portrait with background, visual novel style
scene.low_angle: looking up at castle or mountain, dramatic pixel clouds
scene.overhead: top-down RPG view, tactical perspective, dungeon map style
scene.default: classic JRPG scene composition, character in environment, UI-free

portrait.default: character portrait box style, detailed pixel face, expressive despite limitations, SNES dialogue portrait

location_card.default: title card style, location name area, establishing pixel vista, mode 7 perspective optional

item.default: inventory icon style but larger, item centered, subtle glow effect, treasure chest presentation

moment.default: cutscene composition, dramatic pixel action, special attack animation frame, climactic moment
